Tablet of the Kings:
We who served the last king set this stone apart from its brothers, so that the gate stays shut. Under Teku-Sul the roots of every Hist meet, and the Eye sits where they meet and binds them. Set your hand to it where it sits, and strength runs down every root to every tree. Lift it from its place, and every tree is cut from every other, for good, and the weak among them die alone. content.text:
I took the second seal-stone at Gemin, which completed "The Vault's Stone". I didn't fight anyone or talk to anyone to get it. The Warden of the Vaults had nothing to say to me, and I never spoke to the Unbound Rearguard or the Restless Dead.

I now hold two stones, the Blackrose one and this one. The third is in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, reached by boat near Noota Nara. All three go into the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire, which I'd reach by diving from Bell Station.

The Tablet of the Kings says the Eye strengthens every tree if it's used where it sits. If it's lifted out, every tree is cut off from the others and the weak ones die. So at the Root I must not lift it.

Three questions are still open:
- Why the Unbound seal trees.
- What moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar.
- How Nesh-Deeka knows so much about the Unbound.

The game accepted my final notes and ended.
